planner: Poland (Coastal Front / Front Nadmorski), landing operation on Zealand
source_doc: J. Pałka 2022 (Kwartalnik Historyczny Eng. ed. 6), p.108, paraphrasing 'Plan operacji zaczepnej Frontu Nadmorskiego', 28 February 1965 (AIPN Dok. UW 02958/164, fol. 21)
quote: preceded by four nuclear attacks against anti-landing defences in the vicinity of Roskilde, Slagelse, Næstved, and Vordingborg
notes: SECONDARY: Pałka's English paraphrase of the 1965 Coastal Front plan; primary not accessible online. 4 nuclear strikes for the 4 places (not broken down); 30-50 km from the main landing zone. Plan total 15 missiles ~340 kt plus 5 aerial nuclear strikes (yield not specified).
